label: 俯卧双手托脸
pose_lead: Grounded pose, prone with the face cradled in both hands:
lower_limbs: The stomach lies against the ground, both knees bent so the lower legs swing up, the ankles or feet crossed.
upper_limbs: Both elbows rest on the ground in front of the chest, hands cradling the face from both sides.
torso_head: The chest lifts slightly, the head centered.
weight_silhouette: The body stretches mainly horizontal, the raised legs forming a second point of interest; the whole reads as nearly left-right symmetric.
